description: You are a web accessibility consultant contracted to perform WCAG 2.1 compliance audits on two government websites: ssa.gov (Social Security Administration) and irs.gov (Internal Revenue Service). Your client requires a comprehensive accessibility audit report saved to /home/ga/Desktop/accessibility_audit_report.txt. The report must cover both sites and document specific accessibility issues found on each site, including any violations of WCAG 2.1 success criteria (e.g., missing alt text, color contrast failures, keyboard navigation issues, missing ARIA labels, form accessibility). Use Edge DevTools (including the Lighthouse tool for automated accessibility scoring) to perform the audit. For each site, navigate to the homepage and at least two additional pages (such as a form page, a help page, or a service-specific page). Your report must: (1) name each site and URL audited, (2) list specific WCAG 2.1 success criteria violations found, (3) include Lighthouse accessibility scores for each page audited, (4) prioritize issues by severity (critical, serious, moderate), and (5) provide a brief recommendation for each category of issue found. The report should be thorough enough to present to a government agency's web development team.

metadata.occupation_context: Web Developers, UX Researchers, Accessibility Specialists - WCAG 2.1 compliance auditing for government sites
